example_questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

faq.question: Why do general knowledge quizzes perform well on all platforms?
faq.answer: General knowledge content has the widest potential audience because it isn't limited to a specific fanbase. Everyone wants to test how smart they are. This universal appeal drives high view counts and makes GK quiz channels easier to grow from zero subscribers.

faq.question: How do I keep general knowledge quizzes from being too easy or too hard?
faq.answer: Mix difficulty levels within each video — start with an easy question to hook viewers, include a medium question in the middle, and finish with a harder one to challenge regulars. QuizViral AI's bulk generator lets you easily organize questions by difficulty tier.

faq.question: What's the ideal posting frequency for a general knowledge quiz channel?
faq.answer: Posting 2 to 3 times daily on Shorts/Reels is the sweet spot for growth. General knowledge content has evergreen appeal — questions about science, history, and geography don't expire, so your library compounds in value over time as each video accumulates views.
